name: Ember Cuff
description: Struck cold over a scarred iron stake, the cuff carries every hammer fall on its surface. No two pieces share the same rhythm. Maker story coming soon.

name: Fault Line Neckpiece
description: Hand-cut geometric links interrupted by a single fired-clay fragment. A neckpiece about what breaks and what holds. Maker story coming soon.

name: Kiln Drops
description: Sculpted from river clay and fired in an open kiln, each drop keeps the smoke marks of the burn. Maker story coming soon.

name: Bastar Bell
material: Dhokra bell metal, waxed cotton cord
description: Lost-wax cast in a clay-and-dung mould that is broken to free the metal. A four-thousand-year-old process, worn today. Maker story coming soon.

name: Rann Stack
material: Raw silk thread over brass, set of three
description: Rust, ochre and charcoal thread wound by hand around forged brass cores. Colours pulled from the salt desert at dusk. Maker story coming soon.

name: Anvil Signet
description: A heavy signet with a planished face, forged from a single silver ingot. Made to be worn down, not kept. Maker story coming soon.
